scope: Same managed pipeline implementation: run_pipeline copies three prefixes; start_pipeline/wait_pipeline borrows them. One fresh owner per driver process; no capacity reuse. Shared-host successful finite-input cases, not safety-policy parity, interactivity, a cross-language comparison, universal speed evidence or memory evidence. Driver timer includes owner/caller-buffer initialization, launch, input copy, pumping, capture allocation, binary validation, EOF/reap completion and cleanup; convenience output copying is naturally included. The owner route also performs a terminal zero-slice step and explicit close; these are complete API routes, not an isolated copy-cost experiment. Input/argv/options construction, driver startup and build are excluded from driver wall_ns. Auxiliary process CPU and wall include driver startup and are separately labeled. No memory metric or ranking. One standalone process per warmup/call; each cell has one warmup followed by five calls; four cells shuffled independently in each of nine rounds. All raw output/status/order retained.
